Lena (FinOps): Quick follow-up from the postmortem — delayed-ingest spike led to softened token counts on 6 invoices. Need owners for backfill, invoice corrections, recurrence detection, and customer comms.
Tom (Eng): I can take the backfill and dedupe guard. Plan: patch today, staging smoke tonight, prod backfill tomorrow 02:00 UTC.
Sofia (Metering): Ill own recurrence detection + dashboards. Proposal: page for >=10% in 1h, slack for >=5% in 24h, require 2 consecutive buckets to avoid flapping.
Kai (SRE): Ill own ledger reconcile and the invoice reissue tooling. Need impacted_invoice.csv from FinOps and approval for pro-rated credits.
Lena (FinOps): Uploaded impacted_invoice.csv to FIN-678 and queued a reissue job. billing-bot: reissue job queued id=br-20240901-04 (FIN-678).
billing-bot: Reissue job queued: br-20240901-04 status=pending (FIN-678).
Tom (Eng): Staging smoke passed. Quick validation query I ran:
```
SELECT customer_id, SUM(tokens) tokens
FROM token_events
WHERE ts > now() - interval '4 days'
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 30;
```
Tom (Eng): Root cause looks like a retry that reprocessed 2 shard windows. Patch landed in canary. Backfill set for 02:00 UTC tomorrow.
Sofia (Metering): PR opened: github.com/redwood/meters/pull/550  adds alerting + example notebooks. Will add Grafana panels.
Kai (SRE): Draft reconcile script at //ops/billing/reconcile_dryrun_v3.sh. Dry-run Mon 09:00 UTC; will include pro-rata calculations and a rollback toggle.
Lena (FinOps): Recap: Tom - patch + staging (today), prod backfill (tomorrow 02:00 UTC). Sofia - detection rules + dashboards (Fri AM). Kai - reconcile script + dry-run (Mon 09:00 UTC). Finance will prepare comms after dry-run. Please update this thread with short status notes as milestones complete. :thumbsup:
